高朋滿座#157粵
programme.desc: 悅遇上同學「油脂玲」志玲，身為警察的她在悅滿面前捉拿悍匪。玲捉賊之事被電視廣泛報導，但悅滿面不屑，更認為自己於求學時以風紀身份教育她，令她有此成就。悅感人生沒起伏，想起是因朋向她求婚才令她放棄考警察。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖看不慣完顏康欺負穆家父女，出手教訓，卻不是他對手，幸得王處一相助。王處一中了毒砂掌，所需藥材卻早已被人買光。郭靖與黃蓉河邊相見，看她一身女裝才知她身分。二人夜闖王府找藥材，發現穆家父女被關在牢中。

programme.title: 食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽教你用一種平價蔬菜取代薄荷葉，炮製豬膶蛋花湯，還透露令煲湯豬膶特別爽腍秘方。「大蝦炒鮮奶」煮法容易，處理金華火腿、蝦仁和鮮奶各有竅門。肥媽還教你用近百元的大墨魚，煮出過千元的花膠口感。

programme.title: 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《用心‧家的中秋味道》由星級藝員傅嘉莉、關嘉敏、關楓馨、姚焯菲、黃奕斌、謝雪心參與演出。節目藉着一家四姐妹跟月餅相關的工作、學習與生活日常，帶出連鎖餅店用心製作、研發不同口味、款式的月餅，務求讓顧客能夠透過這種中秋慶節食品，感受家的味道。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肝癌早期病徵不明顯，確診時多已屬中晚期。外科醫生詳析手術治療肝癌的考量因素；而新近的無創組織碎化術準確度更高，也有助減低對其他器官的傷害。社福機構調查顯示，約每十二位中學生就有一人存在學校隱性疏離的風險，常見表現包括獨處、無故缺課等，都是學生輟學前的關鍵訊號，需及早介入支援。機構代表與社工細談學校、家人可怎樣提供相關協助，主持黃劍文亦自言曾面對類似問題。「睇餸食飯」，傅季馨示範「青蔥油涼拌鮑魚」。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 遊茂名必吃海鮮，「好玩隊」帶薛家燕逛魚市場，買馬鮫魚蛋做手信；「夠歎隊」則安排酒店級海鮮餐，黃椒醬蒸蟶子、「蠔炸」好惹味。好心湖呈藍、綠色，團隊踩單車遊湖畔，唱聚大草地兼野餐，皆大歡喜！街頭美食滿載風味，到牛雜一條街嚐牛心頂等少見部位，再往夜市試試臭豆腐、燒豬腦。下一站，「援兵」徐榮、阮浩棕入隊玩轉陽江。汽車服務區成網紅熱點，還可盡情買手信？享用傳統農家菜後輕鬆耍樂，酒店「游乾水」最合家燕姐心意。

programme.title: 東坡家事#18粵
programme.desc: 少游因討得皇上歡心而升官。月娥使計成為一扇軒唯一老闆，大妹一無所有。月娥知道假懷孕後要季常休掉大妹，季常拒絕並與大妹離開陳府。皇上假扮書僮要東坡帶他見琴操。季常遭賊匪打劫，衣服被搶，被途人誤會行乞……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在雜誌上看見百貨公司懸紅尋找槌之子，正好小玉在學校說自己看到槌之子被質疑，兩人加上丸尾一起尋找槌之子，並計劃用獎金成立末玉桃槌之子股份有限公司，將來享受榮華富貴、窮奢極侈。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 藉着兔仔跳、弓箭步等動作充份熱身後，兒童體適能教練Ban Sir引領大家鍛練下肢的爆發力。除了做出原地跳、左右跳的動作外，還會安排兩人一組，利用阻力帶進行訓練，小朋友在家亦可邀請爸媽一同參與，增添互動樂趣。稍作休息後繼續「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，核心訓練需要利用氣球作輔助工具，重點是加強腰腹肌群力量，動作是怎樣的？另外，本集還會播放AI生成動畫《濫竽充數》的下半部。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 小源終於拍攝她第一道甜品烹飪片。正當大家享受茶會之際，烹飪偶像佐藤楓突然闖入攝影廠，把小源帶到外面。出於興趣相近，小楓對小源很有興趣，還說起她對愛麗絲比亞的感情。然而就在這時，多蘭再次現身。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 2003年，政府三十幾年來第一次實施隔離令，將淘大花園E座居民隔離，其後更宣布將所有E座居民全部搬去度假營，新聞掏寶和大家重溫2003年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談粵
programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.title: 東張西望粵 及 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 兩個月前，某的士司機被乘客以紙包飲品襲擊，隨即報案並提供車Cam片段；司機最近再尋求「東張」協助，欲知警方調查進度。荃灣有菜檔經營達三十年，長期為一間泰國餐廳供貨，忽聞對方要清盤破產。餐廳拖欠逾百萬貨款，卻於短時間內以負責人兄長之名原址重開，菜檔一方質疑餐廳藉清盤走數，求助無門！已播畢的《非份之罪》獲好評，陳煒、劉佩玥、徐榮、阮浩棕等演員出席慶功宴，並暢談參演感受。另帶來有關腸道健康與修身的資訊。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2867粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 敢威因某海峽遭封鎖，蒙受極大損失。Ceci主動借錢助他解困，敢威以20%接龍股權作抵押。另一方面，力蓮等人決定不收分文放棄各自的接龍股權，與敢威互不相欠，雙方鬧得不歡而散。其後，眾人分別遇上麻煩，Ceci告知是敢威所為，她還出手幫助各人。Ceci認為敢威太過份，提出讓他改過之法，提議眾人將股份出讓給她，眾人察覺有詐而拒絕，詎料……接龍再次變天，力蓮想到替敢威取回一半話事權的方法，但必須作出犧牲……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#4粵PG
programme.desc: 珠寶廣告構思外洩，原來是家謙兄長葉啟榮的陰謀。幸如憶起夢裡家謙因此被迫辭職，繼威漁人得利因而升職；升職後的繼威隨即向幸如求婚，成為夢中不幸人生的起點。幸如設法協助家謙，不讓夢境成真，終與家謙一同構思出新的廣告主題。家謙成功化解危機，與幸如關係出現進展。熙妍推敲出幸如能「預知未來」，更為此質問她，幸如只好坦白「預知夢」一事。幸如與公司其他女生結為好友，被冷落的雪文心有不甘，決定出手將幸如搶回來……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 前列腺癌是本港男性第三大癌症殺手，且有年輕化趨勢。這集改編自真實案例的患者是職業貨車司機，他原以為腰痠背痛只是工作勞損，怎料求醫後確診前列腺癌第四期。泌尿外科教授吳志輝指出，多肉少菜、高脂飲食都可能是病因，也澄清忍尿、飲水不足並不會誘發前列腺癌。吳教授進一步介紹局部定位治療與前列腺癌的微創手術，都有助減少病人在手術過程中的創傷；調查科也會向中醫教授了解如何協助患者術後調理，以及日常飲食的注意事項。

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#9粵普
programme.desc: 紀封著手查帳，財務部送去幾車亂帳，給他個下馬威。一直帶頭對抗蜜語的小佳被客人投訴偷竊，蜜語不計前嫌解決事件，保住了小佳，並藉此事恩威並施，贏得人心。本已辭職的薛睿不忍紀封孤軍作戰，決定重返浦榮支援他。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#17粵PG
programme.desc: 麗瞳動議撤換主席，天生率先支持，讓定垚看清其真面目。投票之際，啟堂突然出現。思妤收到太陽花以為是高哲所送，沒想到是追求者。定垚得知父親心臟病發真相，報警求助。程凱再次從小慧身上得到靈感，決定研發智能家居，成功獲得董事注資。令翹向明晞推銷自己，明晞要她查探學禮有何動作。明晞估計學禮想參與能源項目，天生決定插手分一杯羹。天生宣布出讓傲堂股份，啟堂私下詢問高哲會否跟自己爭奪。定垚驚悉內地發展部集體辭職…

programme.title: 東坡家事#19粵PG
programme.desc: 大妹和季常在閏之的酒樓幫忙，月娥氣憤。皇上否決安石興建烽火台建議。東坡帶琴操到春釀坊做禡；席上蘇轍批評皇上，說話傳到皇上耳中被責廷杖調職。淑眉懷疑琴操告密，東坡極力維護。淑眉擔心史密聽到自己的秘密……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#157粵
programme.desc: 悅遇上同學「油脂玲」志玲，身為警察的她在悅滿面前捉拿悍匪。玲捉賊之事被電視廣泛報導，但悅滿面不屑，更認為自己於求學時以風紀身份教育她，令她有此成就。悅感人生沒起伏，想起是因朋向她求婚才令她放棄考警察。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 郭靖看不慣完顏康欺負穆家父女，出手教訓，卻不是他對手，幸得王處一相助。王處一中了毒砂掌，所需藥材卻早已被人買光。郭靖與黃蓉河邊相見，看她一身女裝才知她身分。二人夜闖王府找藥材，發現穆家父女被關在牢中。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐對於農夫介紹何遠東、胡鴻鈞兩位嘉賓出場的笑話，搖頭大表失望，卻見農夫一臉「得戚」？原來在保加利亞，點頭與搖頭有相反意思！台灣「問題專員」欣賞店舖內的藝術畫，又大歎咖啡，究竟店內賣甚麼？泰國的超大型餐廳可容納五千位食客，連菜式亦大有名堂，一道「堅離地冬蔭公」因何得名？日本湯料販賣機供應的樽裝調味湯料，內裡又有甚麼特別？今集竟有嘉賓答題捧蛋收場，幸得Do姐大發慈悲送分，方可參與兌換貨幣遊戲……

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: Do姐請來麥美恩、周奕瑋上演精彩對壘。適當使用酒具能增添飲酒時的樂趣；韓國一款像手榴彈般的新奇產品，有何作用？兩位嘉賓信心十足，同時利用雙倍錦囊先拔頭籌，更得Do姐大讚叻叻！法國里昂大街突兀地出現一格紅色地磚？美國亞利桑那一間洞穴酒店，竟建議住客「朝十晚四」離開房間，如不遵從會發生甚麼事？看過貼士的C君試圖用謊話擾亂敵隊，卻被陸永一眼看穿……今集兌換貨幣環節又刷新紀錄！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#158粵
programme.desc: 悅要考輔警，高家為此分成支持與反對兩派。根提議以「兵捉賊」的遊戲來打賭，要悅扮警方，在二十四小時內捉拿由根扮成的恐佈分子，眾家人則配合雙方。追查過程中，悅處處碰璧，要家人多番提示才能繼續遊戲。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 完顏康騙包惜弱說穆家父女已走，郭靖取藥被大蛇襲擊，為保命吸光蛇血後，去救穆家父女得悉穆易是楊鐵心，包惜弱來放人卻沒認出眼前人。黃蓉偷聽完顏洪烈等人對話被發現，憑機智化解，包惜弱向完顏洪烈問起當年之事。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽教煮母親節「大茶飯」，請來狄易達、鄧佩儀、吳業坤、楊斯雅、容天佑作客。川貝清熱潤肺，加入海底椰、豬腱等用健康湯水孝敬母親。「栗子燜米鴨」六號都煮到，還有包糠羊架、蒜子浸黃魚、合掌瓜素雞炒雲耳。

programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.desc: 「馬拉色菌」是皮膚表面的一種共生真菌，過多或會引發毛囊炎、汗斑、脂溢性皮炎，專科醫生細說相關資訊，並提供治療方法。此外，如何從日常習慣減少馬拉色菌的滋生？言語治療師列出嬰幼兒口腔肌肉發展的四個主要階段，有何先天、後天因素會導致口腔肌肉發展障礙？家長切忌過份照顧嬰幼兒，留意可從孩子的進食、語言表現察覺相關問題；治療師亦會帶來改善建議。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製「肉醬意粉」，上桌前撒芝士碎就更吸引。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 下榻陽春溫泉度假酒店，兩隊會師網紅水道玩水戰。享用房內私家溫泉，再歎春砂仁宴，讓家燕姐由外到內養生進補！公路服務區竟有直送海鮮餐，為疲倦旅途注入動力。從豆豉探尋陽江的歷史文化，除了參觀博物館、工廠，還細味豆豉宴及買特產。有餐廳以漆器、風箏做裝飾，炮製出碌鵝等美食，體現對傳統文化的堅持。海陵島的日與夜同樣精彩，團隊登上懸崖泳池嬉水，沿濱海棧道細賞海岸風光；入夜後到珍珠白沙灘吃燒烤大餐，度過悠閒時光！

programme.title: 東坡家事#19粵PG
programme.desc: 大妹和季常在閏之的酒樓幫忙，月娥氣憤。皇上否決安石興建烽火台建議。東坡帶琴操到春釀坊做禡；席上蘇轍批評皇上，說話傳到皇上耳中被責廷杖調職。淑眉懷疑琴操告密，東坡極力維護。淑眉擔心史密聽到自己的秘密……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子從山田口中得知名為《惡鬼之子笑了》的故事，然後有天在公園遇到一名女孩，其後發生的事與故事情節雷同。小丸子被迫與山根一起成立「不虛度二月協會」，首個任務便是要訓練自己早起。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 從一份豐富早餐開展美好的一天，玲玲姐姐卻指平時自己吃一隻雞蛋已飽肚？子健哥哥提議可藉繪畫方式呈現，教大家畫出一份英式早餐，集齊多士、茄汁豆、沙律菜、香腸、番茄及飲品，就更添滿足。這集「開心SHARE」的主題是「我探索過的奇妙地方」，某小女孩曾目睹逾千隻企鵝齊齊「回家」的震撼場面。另有小朋友來稿描述出海深入岩洞的探險經歷，主持們都感同身受，還暢談各自出遊的難忘旅程，以及期待到訪的地方。

programme.title: 皇家少女樂團粵日
programme.desc: 在格林小姐幫助下，奈津找到場地舉行個人演唱會，小源一行都為她感到高興。然而就在這時，史納樂隊四人一同現身，並以萬全狀態向小源三人挑戰。面對史納樂隊的壓倒性合奏，公主合力也無法招架，終於初嘗敗績……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 貝沙灣一個1,500平方呎三房單位，設計師運用大量啞面原木，營造極簡風格，整體效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望之今夜愛回家粵 及 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2868粵
programme.desc: (大結局)熊家眾人離別在即，樹根一反常態暫停工作，也不下廚，經常坐在廳中追看劇集。尚善察覺不妥，為安全起見暗中安裝監控鏡頭。其後，尚善聯絡不上樹根，遂通知眾人。眾人翻看監控錄像片段，發現樹根接連發生家居意外，於是立刻趕回熊家，但途中各自遇到阻滯。回到家後，大家卻發現……最終，眾人作出重大決定。另一方面，尚善、力蓮分別自組公司，卻於同日同一時間開張，並都遇上阻滯……

programme.title: 全城開心．愛回家粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 長壽處境喜劇《愛．回家之開心速遞》，這夜迎來大結局。「根叔」劉丹與「大龍生」羅樂林帶領下，「大妹」滕麗名、「二妹」呂慧儀等「熊家人」，以及「大小姐」林淑敏、「三太」樊亦敏等「龍家人」，還有「接龍員工」齊集歡送派對。眾人屆時會將派送笑聲的「歡樂任務」，正式交棒！新劇《三代同糖》演員車婉婉、吳若希、李茵彤等亦現身接過這份光榮任務，跟現場觀眾同賀《開心速遞》圓滿謝幕，並延續「愛．回家」系列的溫情與歡笑。

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#5粵
programme.desc: 雪文希望在中學籃球隊舊生聚會中令幸如出醜，幸如看穿雪文企圖。熙妍聯同婉蘭、林美淇為幸如重塑形象。幸如在餐廳重遇中學時期的暗戀對象陳浩恩，追問他當年態度突變的真相。同學聚會當晚，幸如拉着一直針對自己的三人組與雪文當面對質，並聯同浩恩，拆穿雪文過往種種謊言。幸如將繼威陷害家謙洩露公司機密的證據，交到家謙手中。最終，揭穿繼威陰謀時雖生變數，但家謙成功留在廣告公司，幸如則被調與一眾新結識的好姊妹成為組員！

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：重症解密粵
programme.desc: 當中樞神經受壓，引致一系列神經系統的症狀，會列入為「脊髓型頸椎病變」。醫生指此症風險將隨年紀增長而提升，惡化速度亦可以很快，並由上肢麻痺、行動不穩，再演變成癱瘓。職業治療師帶來一分鐘的快速測試方法，調查員秀怡的成績達標嗎？醫生建議患者越早開刀越好，手術縱屬高風險，但拖延只會令病情惡化；有哪些常見的手術治療？另外，政府中藥檢測中心會鑑別中藥真偽並確保品質，化驗師如何以DNA技術得出科學數據？

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#10粵普
programme.desc: 接待大客戶Marcos當天，蜜語錯漏百出，後來發現馮凱鑫給假資料。紀封逼走貪腐的賈大廚，提拔翹琪。貞貞搶到商務晚宴訂單，紀封臨陣任命翹琪。宴席海南雞飯被佔用，蜜語以陽春麵替代。晚宴獲好評，貞貞談合作未果…

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
再創世紀#18粵
programme.desc: 定垚與子琳接待來自貴州的黎董，但對方態度冷淡。高哲刻意讓定垚見到天生與德輝會面，提醒她應該要培養自己人。定垚於是請建業幫忙，又得子琳協助，成功令黎董滿意。天生為投資風力發電而變賣天蔭中心，澤雨向啟堂提出換股以買回天蔭中心，遭對方拒絕。明晞替父海泉慶祝壽辰，夫婦二人卻遭海泉奚落。天蔭中心最終被外國天使基金收購，澤雨怒斥天生。定垚為澤雨引薦新加坡財團代表，澤雨為重振家業竟利用定垚，定垚向澤雨提出分手。

programme.title: 東張西望之今夜愛回家粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 「馬拉色菌」是皮膚表面的一種共生真菌，過多或會引發毛囊炎、汗斑、脂溢性皮炎，專科醫生細說相關資訊，並提供治療方法。此外，如何從日常習慣減少馬拉色菌的滋生？言語治療師列出嬰幼兒口腔肌肉發展的四個主要階段，有何先天、後天因素會導致口腔肌肉發展障礙？家長切忌過份照顧嬰幼兒，留意可從孩子的進食、語言表現察覺相關問題；治療師亦會帶來改善建議。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製「肉醬意粉」，上桌前撒芝士碎就更吸引。

programme.title: 玩轉深中懶人包粵
programme.desc: 下榻陽春溫泉度假酒店，兩隊會師網紅水道玩水戰。享用房內私家溫泉，再歎春砂仁宴，讓家燕姐由外到內養生進補！公路服務區竟有直送海鮮餐，為疲倦旅途注入動力。從豆豉探尋陽江的歷史文化，除了參觀博物館、工廠，還細味豆豉宴及買特產。有餐廳以漆器、風箏做裝飾，炮製出碌鵝等美食，體現對傳統文化的堅持。海陵島的日與夜同樣精彩，團隊登上懸崖泳池嬉水，沿濱海棧道細賞海岸風光；入夜後到珍珠白沙灘吃燒烤大餐，度過悠閒時光！

programme.title: 東坡家事#20粵PG
programme.desc: 皇上要立琴操為妃，着她靜候佳音。農民丁東懷「流民圖」被奸官捉拿；安石發現畫作偽造。黎田指有乾女盼皇上立為妃，安石指乾女即琴操且身分有嫌疑。丁東乘有人劫獄逃走；東坡帶洪四和丁東之女丁丁從地道偷入皇宮……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#158粵
programme.desc: 悅要考輔警，高家為此分成支持與反對兩派。根提議以「兵捉賊」的遊戲來打賭，要悅扮警方，在二十四小時內捉拿由根扮成的恐佈分子，眾家人則配合雙方。追查過程中，悅處處碰璧，要家人多番提示才能繼續遊戲。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#3粵普PG
programme.desc: 完顏康騙包惜弱說穆家父女已走，郭靖取藥被大蛇襲擊，為保命吸光蛇血後，去救穆家父女得悉穆易是楊鐵心，包惜弱來放人卻沒認出眼前人。黃蓉偷聽完顏洪烈等人對話被發現，憑機智化解，包惜弱向完顏洪烈問起當年之事。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 中國史上第一個女皇帝武則天為求上位，不擇手段！嘉賓陶傑、游清源大讚她是謀朝篡位的人才！「歷史大誤解」解開江南第一風流才子唐伯虎的風流形象，了解他的真實生活狀況，唐解元還會交代「三笑姻緣」事件。

programme.title: 瘋狂歷史補習社粵
programme.desc: 武則天在高宗駕崩之後，有了第一男寵薛懷義，星級導師陶傑、游清源、王晶品評武后在私生活上的風流與角色需要。「大鑊密探凌凌一」發現某些成語故事，竟然存在詐騙成份！蘇軾大爆「卧薪嘗膽」的主角另有其人！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
沿著運河看中國粵英PG
programme.desc: 歷史學家Andrew Field將帶領觀眾沿著蘊含豐富歷史文化和精湛工程技術的中國大運河一路前行，在充滿活力的城市裡體驗，並探索這一古老航道如何成為21世紀的奇蹟。

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本節目將帶您走進亞洲文化的手工藝術世界，彰顯不同國家的美學。工匠們用心地透過藝術和耐心的加工，創造出了精工細作的文化遺產。工藝及其藝術表現形式作為傳統文化的遺產，為文化多樣性提供了豐富的內容。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 柬埔寨的大山深處，一所以垃圾蓋成的學校改變了人們的命運。貧困的孩子以回收物作為學費，獲得上學機會。印度東北與孟加拉邊界的莫里農，一塵不染的環境並非偶然，而是村民們從小被灌輸了保持衛生、整潔環境的觀念。

programme.title: 仨心友行 3粵
programme.desc: 佳芯即興執導短片，描述兩位主角美恩與穎鏇的曖昧情感，還笑言最開心能使喚「攝影師」諾懿！隨手拈來的樹葉也可奏出悅耳旋律，三女學吹葉笛，竟與「樹熊」撞樣？女神們感情觀大揭秘，美恩、穎鏇同為熱情之人，都曾因「做多咗」令異性朋友產生誤會。佳芯為人直接，會對不感興趣的異性早早落閘！穎鏇自言有選擇困難，習慣依靠伴侶；美恩既渴求空間又要陪伴，甚難捉摸；佳芯則自覺要學撒嬌？真心話遊戲時間，眾人最討厭圈中哪一類人？

programme.title: 豪遊咖啡粵
programme.desc: Ben來到一間特色咖啡店，豆腐花咖啡的味道會是怎樣？花店結合咖啡店，讓客人享用咖啡的同時兼賞花，Ben走進店內感受花香與咖啡香交融的感覺。另一間由冠軍級人馬主理的咖啡店，咖啡師會在客人面前即席沖製手沖咖啡。有咖啡生豆專門店出售逾六十種口味，Mo前往品評一番，其中一款印尼咖啡豆更讓他嚐到驚喜？嘉賓胡定欣原來是因為Mo才愛上咖啡，她還即場沖泡手沖咖啡，讓Mo評分。探究咖啡之道，Mo講解「杯測」的學問。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 相撲是日本傳統國技，相傳起源跟日本神話有關？谷主瀅仴簡介這項運動的演變歷史，並概述相撲力士在場上的特別動作與儀式。她提到從髮型已可分辨力士的地位，最高級別的相撲手，月薪可多達十幾萬港元，待遇頗為優厚。谷主泳嘉、凱文誤以為職業相撲比賽會按體重劃分級別；瀅仴亦補充若要成為職業相撲力士，必須達到特定的身高與體重要求。至於力士的日常飲食，原來每日需攝取最少八千卡路里，而相撲火鍋更是必備餐點之一。

programme.title: 香港美心月餅呈獻:用心‧家的中秋味道粵
programme.desc: 《用心‧家的中秋味道》由星級藝員傅嘉莉、關嘉敏、關楓馨、姚焯菲、黃奕斌、謝雪心參與演出。節目藉着一家四姐妹跟月餅相關的工作、學習與生活日常，帶出連鎖餅店用心製作、研發不同口味、款式的月餅，務求讓顧客能夠透過這種中秋慶節食品，感受家的味道。

programme.title: 滙豐卓越理財呈獻:卓越滙談粵
programme.desc: 累積財富後如何令家庭及子女的未來更有保障？滙豐卓越理財《卓越滙談》聚焦四大主題，涵蓋財富管理、環球升學、家庭健康、旅遊及時尚品味禮遇，結合專業觀點，提供實用資訊讓觀眾更全面規劃未來。

programme.title: 開心大綜藝之暑假玩到盡粵
programme.desc: 暑假結束，穿好校服上學去！校長Bob與訓導主任區永權為星級學生準備了多節課堂，大家先以吹乒乓球形式分班。「插班生」鄧伊婷受罰時，竟斗膽襲擊校長？眾學生接着在浮台上爭位影班相，周志康、楊潮凱明明佔盡好位置，最終卻未能入鏡！美術課要戴特製眼鏡畫畫，楊潮凱充滿自信，人像作品如何？朱智賢故意減筆，可會讓林秀怡更易猜出畫中動物？常識堂，同班成員排排坐答問題，羅毓儀、波波自創歌曲、小說名，令校長陷入瘋狂狀態！

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵PG
programme.desc: 《婚後事》團隊同遊豪華露營，顯現真性情。羅子溢以嘉賓身分露面即拿羅天宇的緋聞開玩笑，可見劇中人的友誼。面對眾人圍攻，天宇索性講真話？除了談到和太太楊茜堯的姐弟戀，子溢亦坦言育有子女後轉變不少。夫妻相處難免有磨擦，子溢指每次冷戰後皆主動哄回太太。同為兩孩之父的子溢、黎諾懿均認同有兄弟姊妹的好處，賴慰玲笑言想趕回家跟丈夫生多一個！精神與肉體出軌引熱議，陳自瑤堅稱兩者都不能接受！諾懿為孩子或能原諒伴侶？

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵PG
programme.desc: 嘉賓曾比特常以音樂抒發情感，卻少談及愛情觀。他大談對結婚、生育的看法，還以結他彈唱<傾城，或讓觀眾勾起劇中畫面。計劃往往趕不上變化，比特稱最重要是遇到對的人！討論女友十大討厭行為，遲到當然上榜，比特自揭曾苦等女生七小時？提到飲酒，某酒量淺之人被爆瘀事。至於亂花錢，比特原來收藏了不少結他；慰玲透露丈夫愛儲櫈，諾懿竟笑言慰玲似張櫈……製作組向四主持投選好感度，最差一人要瞓帳篷，有人急以「輩份」施壓！

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 地圖顯示妖怪村有七彩方塊的反應，阿渡與阿驅兩行人因而會合，一名老婦向他們求救，表示家裡被人強行變成凶宅，一行人來到陰森恐怖的妖怪村，炎上達手下占部靈子聲稱七彩方塊就在屋中。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 只需一條阻力帶，大家就可在家輕鬆鍛練上肢肌肉的爆發力量。阻力帶還可自行調整難度，適合不同程度的小朋友。兒童體適能教練Ban Sir會在「WORKOUT 2GETHER」環節作示範，並鼓勵讓親子一同參與。稍作休息後，改為透過氣球訓練反應與協調能力。其中一個胯下換手拿氣球的動作，教練加入競技元素，讓眾人鬥快完成，增添運動樂趣。「動物好萌友」環節，跟大家一起觀察黑猩猩的日常生活，初步了解牠們的自然習性。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 安妮為考入女王學院努力備試，雖然因馬修病倒而憂心，又為前途感到不安，但最後仍考獲全島第一。之後她在音樂會上朗誦大受讚賞，並逐漸明白，能夠成為真正的自己，已是最珍貴的幸福。

programme.title: 野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國粵
programme.desc: 《野性四季：珍稀野生動物在中國》聯合世界頂尖野生動物拍攝團隊，透過以年為週期的野外追蹤拍攝，為動物國寶留存具有歷史意義和科學價值的珍貴影像檔案。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 有調查發現，超過一半青少年在社交媒體遇過網絡欺凌。有社工認為欺凌問題在年輕人之間很普遍，但不少人認為只是開玩笑，如何在言論自由和避免欺凌之間取得平衡？近年不同社交媒體興起，更容易推送帖子給陌生用戶，令具爭議的話題「爆紅」，加劇網絡欺凌帶來的傷害，對事主造成甚麼影響？不少地區都陸續針對網絡欺凌立法，本港現有的支援和保障又是否足夠？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港系列之細間始終你好粵
programme.desc: 深水埗曾是布料批發的心臟地帶，時移勢易，但仍有布行第二代堅守崗位，藉着加入本地元素，織出新可能。祥師兄跟老闆學用衣車，一試即上手，隨後還收到附有節目標誌的紀念品！位於大坑市區的小小鐵皮屋，擺放了不同類型書籍，負責人不強求賣書，只希望為都市人提供一個停下來閱讀並靜心的空間。尖沙咀有酒吧老闆迷戀港產片與廣東歌，將二者結合開店，讓emo顧客有地方變得開心。除了雞尾酒以廣東歌命名外，吧內裝潢設計有何特色？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻：唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！靚聲歌手梁釗峰反客為主測試《唱錢》系統，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向打爆九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: 香港入境事務處65周年呈獻：身「入」其「境」大挑戰粵
programme.desc: 身「入」其「境」，交換計劃大挑戰！船隻搜查小組專責打擊海上非法入境活動，戴祖儀隨隊深入船隻內部，搜查至多隱蔽位的機房區竟有發現……緊急應變隊要應付羈留中心的突發事，對體能有嚴格要求，朱敏瀚接受遇抗控制、警棍等訓練，還學以致用制伏被羈留人士。製作特區護照過程嚴謹，祖儀體驗監察印製、檢查防偽特徵的步驟，絕不馬虎！入境處亦陪伴市民邁向幸福新階段，敏瀚為一對「新人」辦理簽紙、結婚流程，準新郎卻忘記帶戒指？

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music粵
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高質音樂平台，一眾歌手有展示音樂實力的機會之餘，也可讓樂迷更深入了解歌手的音樂故事。節目邀請「人氣」歌手擔任嘉賓，由嘉賓親自挑選其喜歡的新舊作品，並即場演唱，分享喜愛曲目。而一些樂壇新面孔亦會亮相，透過互動交流，展現音樂潛力。此外，每集緊貼「勁歌金榜」最新形勢，還會帶來不同歌手、創作人或製作人的訪問，跟觀眾暢談作品，以至音樂業界的人和事。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 歌手張與辰於全新環節四出偷師，率先到燒味老店品嚐鹹蛋燒肉飯，並探究脆皮燒肉炮製心得。葉靖儀與施焯日走訪深水埗手作甜品店，品嚐「勁多」配料的芒果楊枝甘露及斑蘭凍，真材實料，用料新鮮。行仔、李海銅再到中環街市「掃街」，遍嚐越式法包、港式黑糖奶茶大福及花生香蕉朱古力大福等亞洲美食。行仔繼而會合施焯日享用只需128元的酒店半自助午餐，沙律、冷盤、熱食、甜品齊備，主菜可選醬烤豬肋骨或香煎盲鰽魚，性價比極高。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵
programme.desc: 本港上演曼城對國際米蘭、祖雲達斯鬥車路士的足球盛會，基亞連尼、韋利等名宿也隨隊抵港並受訪。本地長跑好手施性概、羅楚健藉跑步機，挑戰十小時跑一百公里超馬，與越野跑有何分別？高級組銀牌籃球賽，東方挫南華躋身總決賽，與勝方組滿貫爭標！效力湖人的列夫斯訪港，分享NBA訓練經驗。武狀元大賽邀大灣區隊伍及學生作武術交流，同場加映五百人同練八段錦。此外，港將談及主場出戰劍擊世錦賽感受；另有國際保齡球公開賽花絮。

programme.title: 廉政狙擊#20粵PG
programme.desc: 以凡出境考察前，護照被偷走，卓日昇因而獨自前往考察；卓廷光不虞有詐，敲定注資X 項目，並與屠敏簽訂龍城計劃的合作。慕雪鼓勵繼明振作，兩人決定重新開始，但慕雪隨即遇上車禍身亡。繼明大受打擊，跳樓自殺。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 豪遊咖啡粵
programme.desc: Ben來到一間特色咖啡店，豆腐花咖啡的味道會是怎樣？花店結合咖啡店，讓客人享用咖啡的同時兼賞花，Ben走進店內感受花香與咖啡香交融的感覺。另一間由冠軍級人馬主理的咖啡店，咖啡師會在客人面前即席沖製手沖咖啡。有咖啡生豆專門店出售逾六十種口味，Mo前往品評一番，其中一款印尼咖啡豆更讓他嚐到驚喜？嘉賓胡定欣原來是因為Mo才愛上咖啡，她還即場沖泡手沖咖啡，讓Mo評分。探究咖啡之道，Mo講解「杯測」的學問。

programme.title: 仨心友行 3粵
programme.desc: 佳芯即興執導短片，描述兩位主角美恩與穎鏇的曖昧情感，還笑言最開心能使喚「攝影師」諾懿！隨手拈來的樹葉也可奏出悅耳旋律，三女學吹葉笛，竟與「樹熊」撞樣？女神們感情觀大揭秘，美恩、穎鏇同為熱情之人，都曾因「做多咗」令異性朋友產生誤會。佳芯為人直接，會對不感興趣的異性早早落閘！穎鏇自言有選擇困難，習慣依靠伴侶；美恩既渴求空間又要陪伴，甚難捉摸；佳芯則自覺要學撒嬌？真心話遊戲時間，眾人最討厭圈中哪一類人？

programme.title: 香港婚後事粵PG
programme.desc: 《婚後事》團隊同遊豪華露營，顯現真性情。羅子溢以嘉賓身分露面即拿羅天宇的緋聞開玩笑，可見劇中人的友誼。面對眾人圍攻，天宇索性講真話？除了談到和太太楊茜堯的姐弟戀，子溢亦坦言育有子女後轉變不少。夫妻相處難免有磨擦，子溢指每次冷戰後皆主動哄回太太。同為兩孩之父的子溢、黎諾懿均認同有兄弟姊妹的好處，賴慰玲笑言想趕回家跟丈夫生多一個！精神與肉體出軌引熱議，陳自瑤堅稱兩者都不能接受！諾懿為孩子或能原諒伴侶？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 本節目將帶您走進亞洲文化的手工藝術世界，彰顯不同國家的美學。工匠們用心地透過藝術和耐心的加工，創造出了精工細作的文化遺產。工藝及其藝術表現形式作為傳統文化的遺產，為文化多樣性提供了豐富的內容。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 柬埔寨的大山深處，一所以垃圾蓋成的學校改變了人們的命運。貧困的孩子以回收物作為學費，獲得上學機會。印度東北與孟加拉邊界的莫里農，一塵不染的環境並非偶然，而是村民們從小被灌輸了保持衛生、整潔環境的觀念。

programme.title: 沿著運河看中國粵英PG
programme.desc: 歷史學家Andrew Field將帶領觀眾沿著蘊含豐富歷史文化和精湛工程技術的中國大運河一路前行，在充滿活力的城市裡體驗，並探索這一古老航道如何成為21世紀的奇蹟。

programme.title: 王國戰隊
programme.desc: 頻繁的地震導致各地災情不斷，五大王國決定召集各國的動物英雄－－狼群守護者路卡、熊群保護者諾文、猿猴守望者狄萊拉、獾群守護者提傑，以及貓群守護者米特絲，組成「王國戰隊」！習慣獨自戰鬥的英雄們，不得不學習互相合作，共同守護彼此重視的家園。然而米特絲拒絕加入戰隊，小助手賈巴利自告奮勇，與頂尖英雄們一起作戰！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 陷入純情
programme.desc: 【浪漫速成鄭敬淏愛與復仇的心臟奇蹟】沒血沒淚的冷酷企業代表姜敏浩，有著先天擴張性心藏病，面對隨時有可能死亡的恐懼感，做起事來比誰都還心狠手辣。幼年父親去世時，叔叔奪走了父親的公司，高層主管們也紛紛選擇背叛，龐大壓力下母親選擇輕生留下敏浩一人。復仇心的驅使下，他成為GoldPartners的投資專家，同時也是叔叔公司Hermia的最大債權人團體，看似成功之際，卻心臟病發命在旦夕，所幸出現心臟捐贈者，重生的他因細胞記憶而變得溫暖，甚至對仇人女兒產生微妙的情感，重拾幸福的療癒愛情故事。

programme.title: 燦爛的遺產
programme.desc: 【李昇基、韓孝珠經典代表作！灰姑娘逆襲無賴王子】高恩星在母親因病去世後，從此多了一個沒有血緣關係的妹妹柳承美。繼母城府極深，表面上對恩星姐弟關愛有加，但卻是個非常愛錢的女人。恩星的父親公司破產，且不慎遭搶劫，搶匪戴著他的物品在火災中喪生。繼母誤認死者為丈夫，領取巨額保險金後將恩星姊弟趕出門。恩星偶然救了食品公司社長張淑子，而得到工作，然而張淑子竟然說要把財產全留給恩星，還說要切斷金孫于煥所有的經濟來源。為了逆轉這種情況，于煥只好跟仇人般的恩星一起工作，卻發現自己逐漸喜歡上恩星。

programme.title: 不像三兄弟
programme.desc: 【李浚赫化身金家小兒子婆媳兵團VS警察家族笑料不斷！】聚焦警察爸爸金巡警的三個兒子，廢柴長子安內相被期待壓垮，一事無成卻偷偷戀上單親媽媽；事業型二哥吳大奎功成名就，卻被夾在母親偏心與妻子不滿之間，婚姻岌岌可危；理想派小兒子李浚赫剛當警察，卻愛上了脾氣火爆的富家女。兄弟情誼充滿矛盾和心結，當愛情遭遇現實考驗，婆媳摩擦與婚姻裂痕不斷升級，這個家不再是避風港，而是情緒的火藥庫。笑中帶淚的家庭日常，揭開最真實又狗血的親情與愛情試煉！

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.title: 監獄醫生
programme.desc: 【《千元律師》南宮珉惡鬥《車貞淑醫生》金炳哲，權貴復仇大秀帝王級演技！！】出身無名大學的羅以載，原為大學醫院急診中心的王牌，因醫療事故而吊銷醫生執照，重新考取醫生執照並申請到監獄醫療科，開始進行復仇之路，成為監獄的醫療科長並成功掌握了名門大學醫院理事會。真實體現沒有自己不沾血就能打贏的戰爭。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 呱張爆音團
programme.desc: 12歲的柯阿瑞和他的三個好朋友一起在車庫裡成立了一支樂隊，但是很快的他們就發現他們的樂隊很爛-真的很爛。問題不在他們的音樂或是百變造型，而是因為柯阿瑞寫不出歌詞。他就是想不出酷炫的歌詞嘛，直到......柯阿瑞找到了他姊姊翠娜的日記。「哇！這裡面不只廢話連篇，還有滿滿的青少年煩惱。」柯阿瑞和樂隊「秘密的」用翠娜最新的日記作為他們的創作新曲的歌詞–結果你知道怎麼樣嗎？效果真是棒到要大叫嗷嗷嗷，當然演出機會也越來越多了！這樣一來就皆大歡喜了，對嗎？才怪。翠娜是個超級討人厭的恰查某，完全無法忍受她弟弟的爛樂隊比她還要紅。她想盡辦法要來粉碎他們的夢想。但沒關係啦。柯阿瑞很瞭解他姊姊，嗯...就像姊姊肚子裡的蛔蟲一樣。柯阿瑞總是知道該怎麼做才能讓翠娜炸毛，然後生出他們最欠缺的東西......歌詞！快跟著柯阿瑞和他的樂團嗨翻天吧！看他們為達目的怎麼不擇手段的惡搞翠娜的玻璃心世界吧！

programme.title: 粉紅色口紅
programme.desc: 【朴恩惠經典復仇之作好閨密為渣男反目成仇】因做錯抉擇導致人生本末倒置的女人，經過4次婚姻終於找到真愛與幸福的故事。柳佳恩把初戀情人當成全部，放棄了自己的夢想，卻得到徹頭徹尾的背叛。她的第一任丈夫朴正宇，圖謀佳恩家的財富和地位與佳恩結婚，在達到目的後將佳恩拋棄，轉而和情人美蘭結婚，陰謀奪得了佳恩父親的公司，並間接害死了佳恩的父親。在如此深仇大恨面前，佳恩一步步從一位百合般純潔的女人，變成了帶刺的玫瑰。

programme.title: 沒關係，是一家人
programme.desc: 【母親宣布「卒婚」引發家庭風暴父親失憶揭露大女兒身世秘密】故事圍繞著一對老年夫婦和他們的三名成年子女展開。母親突然宣佈要「卒婚」，因厭倦與脾氣火爆的父親同居，父親則因委屈一度想輕生，卻失敗導致失憶回到22歲，意外揭露大女兒並非親生的秘密。大女兒恩珠發現丈夫是同性戀，內心崩潰，而二女兒恩熙則陷入了複雜的感情糾葛中，被劈腿後又成了上司的情人。小兒子智宇無意中知曉了家族的深藏秘密。「像外人一樣的家人」間產生誤會，不斷磨合理解的家庭劇。

programme.title: 真愛OnAir(完)
programme.desc: 【金荷娜《Onair》詮釋辛辣女星與編劇、導演、經紀人上演修羅場！】傲氣女星吳升雅外冷內熱，渴望被理解；毒舌編劇徐英恩辛辣犀利，因背叛築起心牆；導演李慶民冷面苛刻，與英恩有難解過往；經紀人張基俊圓融細膩，總在混亂中守住分寸。四人因同一部劇合作，從爭執、碰撞、試探，到逐漸看見彼此的脆弱與真心。升雅卸下武裝、英恩學會柔軟、慶民面對情感、基俊守住信念。他們不只拍戲，更在現場演繹真實人生。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 陌生人
programme.desc: 【MOD首播】【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 落花時節又逢君
programme.desc: 【小花妖胡意旋強撩告白高冷花神劉學義，大談反差萌戀！！】不懂情愛、呆萌率直的小花妖紅凝，為了報恩誤闖仙界，卻意外發現自己口中的「仙女姐姐」，竟是身為花神的錦繡。紅凝大膽示愛，直言想當錦繡的「天后」，不是拉著他一起睡覺就是要陪他洗澡，讓這位必須斷情絕愛、恪守仙妖界限的未來天帝繼承者瞬間亂了方寸。

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 那一天，張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫。她眼看著那輛失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她，既沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中。就像鋪天蓋地的穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨過時間的隧道，在一個叫馬爾泰.若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內，重生了…時年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一場震動歷史的「九龍奪嫡」正在暗潮湧動。權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，在被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，張曉，不，是馬爾泰•若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位親王阿哥們交織在一起…她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡的爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有她所愛的，也有愛著她的…若曦最後選擇的究竟是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等歷史的風雲過後，可以陪她看夕陽西下、雲捲雲舒的又將是誰？

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 雙軌(完)
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - AvoMilk
programme.desc: AvoMilk is a plant-based drink with avocado, plant protein, and fiber for daily nutrition and satiety. AvoMilk 是一款植物营养饮品，含牛油果、植物蛋白和膳食纤维，帮助补充营养并增加饱足感。采用冻干牛油果技术，约等于一颗牛油果的营养，再加红枣、非转基因黄豆、藜麦、小麦草和虎乳芝。无添加糖、无奶、无麸质，一冲即饮，顺滑方便。还有可可口味，加入可可粉、虾青素和奇亚籽，像健康巧克力饮品。

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Kplass Cough and Flu Relief Patch
programme.desc: Drug-free patches use Far Infrared and acupoint therapy to relieve cold and flu symptoms naturally. The Cold &amp;amp; Flu Patch eases a blocked nose, sinus pressure and chills. The Cough Relief Patch comes in adult and child versions to soothe coughs and calm throat irritation for easier breathing. programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Naturalle Sugar Care Tea
programme.desc: Crafted from 100% natural leaves including gymnema, mulberry and green tea, the Naturalle Sugar Care tea is mild-flavoured and low in calories. Naturalle 糖适宁茶采用 100% 天然叶材精制而成，包括匙羹藤、桑叶与绿茶，口感清淡、低热量。糖适宁茶是适合餐后饮用，有助于抑制对甜食的渴望和维持血糖健康水平，非常适合经常摄取高碳水或含糖食物的人士饮用

programme.title: The Wonder Shop (Home Shopping) - Kinohimitsu Essence of Chicken
programme.desc: Taste Better, feel better. This premium essence of chicken helps boost energy, stamina, and immunity. programme.desc: Hyundai Cup 2026 is the 16th ASEAN Championship, the biennial international men's football championship of Southeast Asia organised by the ASEAN Football Federation (AFF) and will be the 1st edition under the name ASEAN Hyundai Cup. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT

But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The In Charge Badge
programme.desc: What are the rules about being in charge? Make a plan, keep everyone happy, make decisions, lead by example and listen. Roly takes that one so seriously he gets a bit overwhelmed.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: The New Shaolin Boxers
programme.desc: Young carriage driver Kin offends the gangsters by saving a young girl. His boss immediately fires him to avoid getting into trouble. Since then, Kin is determined to protect the weak and learns the “Tsai Li Fu” style of martial arts from a Shaolin master to challenge the gangsters, finally beating them.

programme.title: Killer Clans
programme.desc: This intriguing wuxia saga is packed with conspiracies, power schemes and sword fights to produce a perfect blend of great action and gripping drama. The movie centres around the struggle for underworld supremacy between two clans, where the line between good and evil is not always that clear-cut.

programme.title: Life Gamble
programme.desc: Martial arts master Yu has retired for years but is invited to join force with another master Tao to fight against the four famous thieves and retrieve the stolen Dragon Jade. However, Tao's real plan is to possess the treasure himself and kills Yu after he defeats the thieves...

programme.title: The Magic Blade
programme.desc: The movie depicts Fu Hong Xue fighting against the formidable conspirator Master Yu and seeing through his deception. The brilliantly choreographed fights, glorious settings, superb cinematography and strong casts define this movie as a highpoint in Wu Xia cinema.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rong's hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Invincible Shaolin
programme.desc: An evil Qing general comes up with a plan to rid the Shaolin masters once and for all. He invites three Northern Shaolin experts to fight against three Southern Shaolin disciples. After the contest, the general secretly kills the Southerners and places the blame on the Northerners. This leads to in-fighting between both Shaolin schools.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Demon of the Lute
programme.desc: Lute demon Chin Mo has reappeared in the world to wreak havoc. Hsiao Feng Ling is ordered to help find a special bow and arrows that can counter the demon. Only Chiao Yin knows the whereabouts of the weapon. Hsiao and her classmate Old Naughty set out on an arduous journey to find Chiao. After overcoming many obstacles, they catch Chin Mo's man trying to snatch the bow and manage to stop him in time....

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: Threatened by the Yuan who are closing in to rule the whole of China, a band of Song survivors band together to save their prime minister. This bold and fearless heroes fighting for their cause are led by international star, Lo Lieh (Glass Tears, Killer Clans) and Shi Szu (Lovers Destiny), who must fight their way out of trap after trap. But they can't escape them all, and eventually the two end up in prison... it is either death or a fight to the end!

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp;amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Delightful Forest
programme.desc: The legendary hero Wu Sung is sent to a prison in Meng province after murdering his adulterous sister-in-law and her lover. While in prison, the officer Shih En spares Wu the humiliating baton punishment. Owing Shih a favour, Wu decides to help Shih get his restaurant back at all costs when it was forcefully taken over by a local thug.

programme.title: The Black Falcon
programme.desc: Jenny Hu and veteran co-star Margaret Tu Chuan join longtime0020idol Paul Chang Chung in a battle against the notorious Black Falcon crime mob in Singapore. Together they have to face forgery, fire, and even poisoned needles to stop the mob.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: To Kill a Jaguar
programme.desc: Set in 1920s Shanghai, a village girl journeys to the big city in search of her father and meets her childhood friend Jaguar, who works for the mob boss Kam. In a world controlled by the mobs, it is a test of survival for all as Jaguar allies himself with ace gunman Ko Tang, to take over Kam's empire.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Invincible Fist
programme.desc: A dedicated chief constable nicknamed “The Invincible Fist” is chasing after a band of bandits near a village one day and encounters an innocent blind girl. He quickly falls in love with her, but finds out she is the daughter of a vicious bandit. Will he kill the father of his lover?

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires (or fake ones!).

programme.title: The New One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: David Chiang plays the all-new one-armed hero - a swordsman who chops off his right arm rather than live with dishonour. When the love of his life is kidnapped and his best friend is murdered by the evil gang, it is time to battle.

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Death Duel
programme.desc: Third Master is a renowned swordsman in the martial arts world, but the constant challenges by other swordsmen compel him to fake his death and pursue a secluded life. This does not prevent others from seeking him out to challenge him however, and he is forced to return to fight his way till the end.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Lady With A Sword
programme.desc: Swordswoman Feng tries to find a group of villains responsible for her eldest sister's death, but is shocked to discover that her fiancé, Jin, is one of them. At the same time, Jin's mother and the two other killers are planning to kill Feng. Can Feng fight back and take her revenge?

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: In the Han Dynasty, the tyrannical Prime Minister Dong Zuo takes control of the country, so Minister Wang plots to take him down using Diau Charn's beauty. Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Little Hero
programme.desc: An orphan, Little Bastard is taken on and trained as a fighter by a hermit. When Little Bastard grows up, he feels he is old enough to go out and look for his parents. Luckily for him, he befriends a beggar, Hsiao Yi, who being street-wise, manages to help him find his family, but somehow gets into trouble with the gang.

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Descendant of the Sun
programme.desc: Shi Sheng is adopted by an old carpenter and grows up to possess extraordinary superpowers. One day, he unexpectedly discovers his identity as the son of the solar deity and learns that his power will be lost during solar eclipse. When an evil spirit appears and wreaks havoc, Shi Sheng must beat him in an ultimate duel to save the world.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Lo's brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hu's house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hu's pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Bat Without Wings
programme.desc: The Bat Without Wings, a notorious rapist-murderer, has returned after a five-year absence. A young swordsman and a convoy master investigate the case and suspect that the Bat may be framed. A saying goes that a treasure map is hidden under the Bat's knife, so they try to use that to hunt the real culprit…

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the team’s downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: 36 Secrets of Courtship
programme.desc: This erotic comedy features three lotharios who vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School -- an extremely sexy institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Warlord Lui Dai Ngau commands a powerful army but fails to win the heart of Lau Yiu, whom he keeps in his mansion against her will. Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him…

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li’s daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Jailed for accidental manslaughter, martial arts master Har Hao Mo discovers a killer targeting kung fu masters across Hong Kong. Determined to stop the murders, he helps police track down Fung Yu Sau, a ruthless fighter obsessed with proving his supremacy. As the killings continue, the two martial artists are drawn toward a deadly showdown.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau’s Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city’s casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Hail the Judge
programme.desc: A low level magistrate is run out of town for defending a beautiful murder suspect. Through a series of comedic events he ascends to the top rank &amp;amp; returns looking for revenge.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey1-Pandora's box
programme.desc: Joker, a carefree bandit leader, learns he is the reincarnation of the Monkey King. As demons and immortals close in, he is drawn into a chaotic, time-bending journey with the mystical Pandora’s Box. Caught between past and present, he must choose between destiny and freedom.

programme.title: A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: In 1913, a brutal massacre forces Hua into exile in America. Reunited with his pregnant wife, tragedy strikes again when their home burns down on the night she gives birth to twins, killing her while their daughter gets kidnapped. Sixteen years later, as his son finds him, Hua confronts his ultimate nemesis in a climactic duel on top of the Statue of Liberty.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min dies mysteriously in a hospital rumoured to be haunted. Soon after, her photographer receives eerie phone calls, a writer suffers a bizarre car accident, and Min’s friend suddenly vanishes. As fear spreads, dark secrets and supernatural forces emerge, drawing them into a terrifying nightmare linked to Min’s death.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister’s daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man…

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to “Casino Tycoon”. 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down…

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father’s land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang’s custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, Long Wei becomes the firm’s VR fighter and dons the newly invented armour. However, as mysterious armed men break in, a fierce battle has just begun...

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels
programme.desc: Conman Sing is forced by a loan shark to team up with another con artist Betty to steal from a luxurious house. When they encounter other conmen who disguise themselves as the house owners to steal the antiques, they pretend to be their rich guests. As both sides know the other’s true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey2-Cinderella
programme.desc: Following the chaos unleashed by Pandora’s Box, Joker is thrust through time and begins to awaken as the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Torn between mortal emotions and divine destiny, he struggles to reconcile his love for Zixia Fairy with the responsibilities of his past.

programme.title: The Mask of Shura of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: 18 years ago, the evil Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil. When the baby grows up, he takes control of the mask and becomes Fire Cloud’s successor as the city’s guard.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school’s stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveller
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Let The Bullets Fly
programme.desc: Bandit Zhang Mu Zhi poses as a county chief and arrives in Goose Town hoping to make a fortune, only to encounter the ruthless and manipulative tycoon Huang Si Lang, who controls the town with fear and corruption. As the two powerful men clash, a thrilling battle of wits, deception, greed and gunfire erupts, throwing the entire town into chaos.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Leeds United vs Liverpool (MW15) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Leeds have won just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Liverpool (D3 L8), beating them 2-1 at Anfield in October 2022.

programme.title: Aston Villa vs Arsenal (MW15) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Since their return to the competition in 2019, Aston Villa have won five of their 12 Premier League games against Arsenal (D1 L6), as many as they had in their previous 45 against the Gunners before relegation (D14 L26).

programme.title: Manchester United vs Bournemouth (MW16) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just one of their last nine Premier League games (W5 D3), going down 1-0 at home to Everton. They’ve won more points in these nine games (18) than they had in their previous 17 matches combined (16 – W4 D4 L9).

programme.title: Fulham vs Manchester City (MW14) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Fulham have lost their last 18 meetings with Manchester City in all competitions, the longest losing run one side has had against another in English football history.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Aston Villa (MW18) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Aston Villa have won 2 of last 3 PL visits (L1) – had won only 2 of previous 21 PL visits (D4 L15).

programme.title: Leeds United vs Crystal Palace (MW17) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Leeds have lost their last two Premier League games against Crystal Palace, as many as they had in their previous nine (W5 D2).

programme.title: Leeds United vs Crystal Palace (MW17) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Leeds have lost their last two Premier League games against Crystal Palace, as many as they had in their previous nine (W5 D2).

programme.title: Nottingham Forest vs Wolverhampton Wanderers (MW26) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Forest haven’t done the league double over Wolves since 2012-13 in the Championship – winning 2-1 away before a 3-1 home win.

programme.title: Newcastle United vs Leeds United (MW21) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Newcastle have won just one of their last seven Premier League games against Leeds (D4 L2), beating them 1-0 at Elland Road in January 2022.

programme.title: Arsenal vs Aston Villa (MW19) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Aston Villa are only team to beat Arsenal 3 times in PL since start of 23-24 (3 of Arsenal’s 11 PL defeats in total).

programme.title: Manchester United vs Manchester City (MW22) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Man City have won more Premier League away games against Man Utd than any other visiting side (9), while only Liverpool (41) have scored more goals at Old Trafford than the Citizens (37).

programme.title: Bournemouth vs Liverpool (MW23) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Liverpool are unbeaten in their last 10 Premier League games, the longest current run of any side (W4 D6). However, they’ve drawn each of their last four, last drawing more consecutive league games in OctoberNovember 1980 (5).

programme.title: Arsenal vs Manchester United (MW23) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester United are winless in their last six Premier League games against Arsenal (D1 L5) – they’ve never gone seven in a row without a win against the Gunners in their league history.

programme.title: Chelsea vs West Ham United (MW24) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: West Ham have won just one of their last 19 Premier League away games against Chelsea (D4 L14), losing the last five in a row since a 1-0 victory in November 2019.

programme.title: Bournemouth vs Arsenal (MW20) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Having won just one of their first 14 Premier League games against Arsenal (D2 L11), Bournemouth did the double over the Gunners last season.

programme.title: Manchester United vs Fulham (MW24) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Manchester United have lost just one of their last 20 Premier League games against Fulham (W15 D4), going down 2-1 at Old Trafford in February 2024.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Manchester City (MW25) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Following their 3-0 win at the Etihad in November, Manchester City are looking to complete their first league double over Liverpool since 1936-37, which was also the last time they won consecutive league games against them.

programme.title: Tottenham Hotspur vs Manchester City (MW24) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Tottenham have completed the Premier League double over Manchester City nine times so far, more than they have any other opponent. Meanwhile, only Chelsea (10) have done so more against the Citizens.

programme.title: Cobra Kai S3 - Aftermath

programme.desc: Daniel's tarnished public image takes a toll on his sales, leading to a takeover offer. Johnny tries to raise money for Miguel's surgery.

programme.desc: Following an important meeting in Japan, Daniel revisits Mr. Miyagi's hometown in Okinawa. Johnny attempts to reconnect with Robby.

programme.desc: Old wounds begin to heal at a country club Christmas party, but a brutal assault by Kreese's students leads to new betrayals and alliances.

programme.desc: Johnny picks up defensive strategies while Daniels learns how to go on the offensive. Amanda confronts Tory. New kid Kenny is bullied at school.

programme.desc: From epic waterfalls to hidden street art and one last party in Gothenburg — Robbie's Swedish story ends with a cinematic splash.

programme.desc: On a bike trip across the Nagaland, Rohan gets a chance to meet some fearless and simple Naga tribes.

programme.title: A Bride For A Ride - EP9
programme.desc: Foolhardy TIGER WONG (Chin Kar Lok) is annoyed with his mother LAU BING TAI (Gigi Wong) for consistently pressuring him to get married. He therefore snatches CHOW MAN BUN (Sammul Chan) who is in female disguise to be his bride and arranges for BUN to stay at his younger sister WONG SAU YING (Nancy Wu)'s chamber for the night. After this, TIGER has no choice but to marry YING to BUN while setting up strict rules to torture BUN in the house. Clever BUN makes use of the chivalrous woman MO SAM LEUN

programme.title: My Unfair Lady - EP27
programme.desc: Career driven LING MAN (Jessica Hester Hsuan) is a property management executive with a golden touch, and the shopping malls under her leadership have won many awards. She is also a control freak. As her number one assistant, her cousin LING YU-KEN (Natalie Tong) is totally under her thumb and hard-working. She learns to flirt superficially, helping LING MAN smooth over many problems. Just as LING MAN is looking forward to moving up the company to be appointed to the board of directors, the comp

programme.title: Barrack O'Karma - EP9
programme.desc: Siu Wai-ming (Joel Chan) becomes a security guard at Twilight Mansion, a run-down place where dodgy characters roam around. He encounters an occupant by the name of Alex (Selena Lee), who is an air hostess and a dead ringer for some qipao clad woman that keeps clinging to him in his dreams. Siu gets closer to Alex and finds out they are somehow interrelated. Meanwhile, strange things keep happening at Twilight Mansion as life experiences and curious stories of other occupants take center stage.

programme.title: Relic Of An Emissary - EP20
programme.desc: The founder and first emperor of the Ming Dynasty CHU YUEN-CHEUNG has passed away. CHU WAN-MAN (Chan Shan Chung), who is the son of his designated heir, is made his successor. MAN's bodyguard NGO SIU-FUNG (Michael Tse) is ordered to search for CHEUNG's lost will. In the course of his investigation, he gets to know the Prince of Yin CHU TAI's (Joe Ma) counselor MA SAM-PO (Sammul Chan). FUNG and PO appreciate each other, but FUNG reminds himself not to drop his guard, as TAI is coveting the throne

programme.title: Always And Ever - EP6
programme.desc: Due to a heartrending vow, YUEN KAM-CHEONG (Bobby Au Yeung), an Inspector of the Criminal Intelligence Bureau, has mistakenly killed his girlfriend YEUNG TSIK-SUET (Esther Kwan). Being so grief-stricken, KAM-CHEONG has an out-of-body experience, travelling back in time to the Song Dynasty. Having attached his soul to BAO ZHENG (Bobby Au Yeung), the magistrate of Song's capital Kaifeng, he is shocked to see HON SEUNG-SEUNG (Esther Kwan), who looks just like TSIK-SUET, right in front of his ey
